patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-fashion photography is used as immersive hero backgrounds, often with minimal text overlays, creating a strong visual impact.
A sophisticated serif typeface is used for the brand logo and key headings, contrasted with a clean, minimalist sans-serif for body text and navigation, often in uppercase for emphasis.
A stark monochromatic palette of black, white, and various greys forms the base, punctuated by a single, bold accent color (red) for specific product highlights or interactive elements.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, while large hero background images exhibit a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content.
The page structure alternates between expansive, full-width image-heavy hero sections and more structured content blocks like product grids or centered informational text.

technique_notes: To rebuild the sticky navigation, create a fixed header element that maintains its position at the top of the viewport, ensuring it has a high z-index to overlay scrolling content.

For the hero sections, implement large background images that are set to cover the container and use a fixed or slow-scrolling background attachment to achieve a subtle parallax effect as foreground text and calls-to-action scroll over them.

Typography is established by pairing a refined serif font for brand elements and titles with a highly legible, minimalist sans-serif for all other text, often using uppercase styling for calls to action and labels to maintain a clean, editorial feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~2.5x body) are paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text, and small, uppercase sans-serif labels and CTAs.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical padding around hero sections and between major content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and breathing room.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, editorial use of high-fashion photography as full-bleed hero sections, creating an immersive and luxurious brand experience. The stark black and white palette, punctuated by a single accent color, combined with sophisticated typography, elevates the visual narrative beyond a typical e-commerce site.
